text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ

words.gloss_range: demonstrative pointer to an already visible state, with plural address built into the form
words.prose: The opening {{ar:ذَٰلِكُم}} ({{tr:dhālikum}}) points to a state already before the audience, then makes that state face the same plural group that confessed in 40:11. The cause comes after the verdict-pointer, so the reader first receives the condition as adjudicated and only then hears the diagnostic reversal behind it; even the addressed ending is pulled audibly into the causal explanation that follows.

topics.headline: verdict before diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by presenting the addressees’ state as already adjudicated before explaining its cause.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is discourse-linked to the preceding plea and the causal clause that follows, so it can hold verdict and diagnosis together.

topics.headline: plural deictic address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pointed state is aimed directly at the same plural group that confessed in 40:11.
topics.reason: The bound plural address and later second-person verbs keep the prior speakers under direct indictment.

topics.headline: address sealed into cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word’s addressed ending is audibly pulled into the causal explanation that follows.
topics.reason: The sound observation adds a small but coherent payoff: the addressed group is not detachable from the explanation.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition that fastens the coming asserted contrast to the indicated verdict-state
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the next clause the ground of the pointed verdict-state. Its force is causal and attaching at once: the addressees are not merely described after the fact; their condition is fastened to the pattern that follows, while the ayah will later move from this diagnosis to ownership of judgment.

topics.headline: causal attachment to asserted fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following contrast is the reason for the verdict-state, not merely the next event in sequence.
topics.reason: The preposition is attached to the asserted clause and functions as causal ground for the opening demonstrative.

topics.headline: prepositional movement to judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a grammatical arc from why the condemned state exists to who owns judgment over it.
topics.reason: The opening causal preposition and closing ownership preposition form a coherent structural payoff without forcing either particle beyond its local role.

words.gloss_range: assertive situation-particle that packages the coming two-branch reversal as one explanatory fact
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:annahu}}) compresses the coming contrast into one asserted explanatory fact. The attached pronoun can carry the whole situation rather than a single noun antecedent, so the two conditions that follow unfold what has already been packaged as the reason for the verdict. That package also answers the prior confession and unanswered escape question in 40:11 with causal refusal rather than a way out.

topics.headline: compressed explanatory fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two opposed responses are first packaged as one explanatory fact and only then unpacked.
topics.reason: The particle plus pronoun can carry situation-level content, and the following conditional branches supply that content.

topics.headline: causal refusal of escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior confession and unanswered escape question in 40:11 receive a causal explanation rather than an exit.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the clause to 40:11, while the local syntax supports it as the explanation of the pointed state.

words.gloss_range: recurrent temporal-condition, closer to whenever than a remote hypothetical if
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) frames the first branch as a recurrent trigger, not a distant possibility. That makes exclusive invocation the repeated moment at which the addressees show themselves, while the later alternate condition is heard against this whenever-like opening. Its open entry also gives the first condition a spacious recitational launch before the tighter rejection beat.

topics.headline: whenever-condition for rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exclusive invocation is framed as a repeated trigger that exposes a characteristic response.
topics.reason: The temporal-conditional adverb governs the first branch and is answered by the rejection verb.

topics.headline: first branch against second branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two particles make the branches parallel but not identical: recurrent exclusive invocation versus alternate association.
topics.reason: The first condition and the later if-condition are syntactically paired while carrying different discourse force.

topics.headline: broad entry into first condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first condition opening with a spacious recitational entry before the tighter response-beat.
topics.reason: The sound row has local payoff as cadence, though it does not control the parse.

words.gloss_range: passive invocation/calling event; local sense is exclusive divine invocation rather than generic naming or claim-making
words.root_gloss_range: broad calling, naming, summoning, claiming, and invoking range; the local passive frame selects invocation/reference while leaving the caller unexpressed
words.prose: {{ar:دُعِىَ}} ({{tr:duʿiya}}) hides the caller and lets the invocation-event itself carry the test. The completed passive event points the whole clause toward the invoked name and its exclusivity; the broad calling root is narrowed here to divine invocation, with later surah echoes in 40:14 and 40:42 showing the same field turned into command and rival call.

topics.headline: caller hidden, response exposed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah removes the caller from view and makes the addressees’ response to exclusive invocation the judged fact.
topics.reason: The verb is Form I perfect passive under the recurrent condition, and attachment evidence warns against adding an explanatory agent.

topics.headline: calling range narrowed to invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices directed appeal toward Allah alone, while the local frame prevents the broader calling, naming, and claim range from all becoming active senses.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but the passive subject and the following exclusivity select divine invocation/reference here.

topics.headline: passive diagnosis answered by later calls
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this passive invocation belongs to a surah-wide field of rival calls, including the command to invoke sincerely in 40:14 and the reversed call in 40:42.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references and survive as a network payoff without making those later scenes control the local parse.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the invoked passive subject, not a generic deity label
words.root_gloss_range: worship, devotion, refuge, and turning pressure around the divine name; local grammar fixes the proper name as the invoked subject
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:llāhu}}) is the fixed proper name and the passive subject of the invocation, so the rejection answers Allah being invoked, not a human speaker. The worship and refuge pressure around {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) makes the exclusivity a matter of total orientation, and the Allah-alone aversion known from 39:45 is here given judicial grammar. The same name later returns as judgment’s possessor.

topics.headline: proper name as passive subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Allah is grammatically the invoked one, fixed by proper name before exclusivity excludes partners.
topics.reason: The name is the nominative passive subject of the invocation verb and is not a generic deity label.

topics.headline: devotion pressure around the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exclusive invocation involves devotion and refuge, while the derivational dispute remains background pressure rather than a replacement for the proper-name parse.
topics.reason: The derivational material is meaningful but must be limited by the local proper-noun role.

topics.headline: Allah-alone aversion in judicial grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the aversion to Allah alone named in 39:45 is here given the grammar of judicial cause.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete polarity evidence and a 39:45 parallel, while local syntax keeps 40:12 as the governing scene.

topics.headline: name frames diagnosis and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name moves from invoked subject to judgment’s possessor, enclosing the human reversal.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name is locally visible at the first condition and at the verdict clause, creating a structural frame.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial exclusivity: Allah is invoked alone, with the suffix tying aloneness to the named referent
words.root_gloss_range: oneness, singleness, solitude, and unicity range; local syntax applies it as event-level exclusivity, not abstract arithmetic alone
words.prose: {{ar:وَحْدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:waḥdahu}}) applies aloneness as the circumstance of the invocation. The suffix ties that exclusivity to Allah personally, and the word becomes the pressure point of the ayah: the first branch removes every associate before the second branch tests what happens when association is introduced. The variant apparatus tests whether that exclusivity could be expanded, but the canonical local form keeps it unexpanded; 112:1, 40:14, and 40:84 show this uniqueness tested, commanded sincerely, and conceded too late.

topics.headline: aloneness as invocation circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that aloneness is not a detached doctrine label; it is the condition under which Allah is invoked and rejection appears.
topics.reason: The noun is circumstantial with a suffix returning to Allah, so exclusivity modifies the invocation event.

topics.headline: lexical antithesis to association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah’s reversal is built first as oneness versus association, before the response verbs name rejection and belief.
topics.reason: The local opposition between the exclusivity expression and the later association verb is syntactically and semantically licensed.

topics.headline: plus reading tests exclusivity boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant apparatus identifies the pressure point of exclusivity, while the canonical local reading remains Allah-alone and is not expanded.
topics.reason: The plus reading is useful as contrast, but it must not govern or enlarge the canonical parse.

topics.headline: uniqueness tested in invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that uniqueness is tested in practice here, with 112:1 naming divine uniqueness, 40:14 answering with sincere devotion, and 40:84 showing a late concession.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references and preserve the operational payoff without changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: settled collective rejection of the Allah-alone frame, with no explicit object narrowing the target
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, ingratitude, and disbelief range; local context selects rejection of exclusive divine reference while retaining covering imagery
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرْتُمْ}} ({{tr:kafartum}}) names the collective settled response to that Allah-alone frame. Because no object is stated, the rejection falls on the whole exclusive-invocation condition; the covering-denial field of {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) is narrowed to active rejection while still letting the reader feel recognition being covered over. The word also closes the first branch sharply before the alternate opens, exposing the inverted polarity in which rejection answers oneness while belief appears under association, unlike the ordinary contrast in 2:257.

topics.headline: settled plural response with open object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees collectively reject the whole Allah-alone frame, not a narrowly stated object.
topics.reason: The second-person perfect verb has no explicit object and answers the recurrent condition.

topics.headline: covering image in rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rejection as a covering over recognition, while the local form excludes expiatory or guilt-removing branches.
topics.reason: The root image survives as semantic pressure, but the local Form I response selects denial/rejection rather than expiation.

topics.headline: rejection paired with oneness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shocking polarity reversal: rejection answers oneness, while belief appears only under association, unlike the normal contrast in 2:257.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local response pair with broader belief/rejection polarity and concrete parallels.

topics.headline: rejection beat before alternate branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first branch closing sharply before the alternate condition begins.
topics.reason: The cadence row provides a local sound payoff tied to branch structure.

words.gloss_range: coordinator that joins the second condition to the first as an added contrastive branch
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the second conditional branch to the first instead of letting it drift as a separate case. It coordinates, but the opposed conditions make the coordination contrastive: the added branch exposes the reversal already begun in the first.

topics.headline: second branch joined to first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the association condition is linked to the first branch as its counterpart, not introduced as an unrelated aside.
topics.reason: The conjunction stands before the conditional particle and connects the whole second branch.

topics.headline: addition exposing opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary coordination becomes adversative because the two coordinated branches oppose one another.
topics.reason: The particle remains coordinative, while local semantic opposition supplies contrastive force.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle governing the association branch and its response
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) governs the association branch and the belief-response that answers it. Beside the earlier recurrent condition, this particle gives the second scene an if-branch force, so the reader hears trust as dependent on the introduction of mediation.

topics.headline: if-particle governing branch and response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that association is grammatically made the condition under which the belief-response appears.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the passive association verb and the response verb.

topics.headline: alternate if-branch after whenever branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that trust is exposed as conditional on mediation, set against the recurrent Allah-alone trigger.
topics.reason: The particle’s conditional force is sharpened by contrast with the earlier temporal-condition.

words.gloss_range: passive Form IV association in relation to Allah; no associator or partner is named
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, participation, partnership, and association range; local Form IV passive selects an introduced association-relation, not natural mutual sharing
words.prose: {{ar:يُشْرَكْ}} ({{tr:yushrak}}) is passive and conditioned, so the associator and the partner stay unnamed while the relation itself comes forward. {{ar:ش ر ك}} ({{tr:sh-r-k}}) brings sharing and partnership pressure, but the Form IV passive narrows it to a made association with Allah rather than any natural shared power. This same grave relation is marked in 4:48 and returns as rival-call content in 40:42, while the passive condition and the active response divide ritual agency from the addressees’ exposed preference.

topics.headline: association relation foregrounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah hides the associator and partner so the association relation itself becomes the attractive condition.
topics.reason: The verb is passive, governed by the conditional particle, and completed by a prepositional complement.

topics.headline: sharing range narrowed to shirk relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices broad sharing and partnership pressure, while local relation to Allah blocks an ordinary social-participation reading.
topics.reason: The root range is narrowed by the prepositional complement and the surrounding worship-reversal frame.

topics.headline: partnership introduced, not inherent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that partnership is presented as something introduced into the relation, not something naturally shared with Allah.
topics.reason: The Form IV passive supports caused or introduced association and contrasts with mutual participation wording.

topics.headline: grave cross-passage association formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition they trust is the same grave association relation marked in 4:48 and later returns as rival-call content in 40:42.
topics.reason: The concrete references preserve formula weight without importing those verses as the local parse.

topics.headline: second branch completes reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that passive conditions and active responses divide responsibility: ritual agents disappear, but the addressees’ preference is exposed.
topics.reason: The association verb directly answers the exclusivity expression and completes the two-pair reversal.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun that returns the association relation to the same divine referent
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) keeps the second branch tied to the same divine referent as the first. The preposition marks association with or in relation to Him, and the bound pronoun makes the inversion precise: the one invoked alone is the one around whom association is now introduced. Its position also makes that relation heard before the belief-response arrives.

topics.headline: same divine referent in both branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second branch concerns the same Allah as the first, with the relation changed from alone to associated-with.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix returns to Allah and makes the branch an inversion rather than a separate partnership case.

topics.headline: with-Him relation of association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that association is marked as a relation with or in relation to Allah, widening the issue beyond a named physical partner.
topics.reason: The preposition is governed by the association verb and bound to the divine pronoun.

topics.headline: relation heard before response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the association relation to Allah is placed between the passive condition and the belief-response.
topics.reason: The word order forces the relation to be heard before the response verb arrives.

words.gloss_range: second-person belief/trust response that appears under the association condition, with no explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: safety, trust, security, and belief range; local Form IV selects trust-affirmation rather than mere absence of fear
words.prose: {{ar:تُؤْمِنُوا۟}} ({{tr:tuʾminū}}) is the addressees’ response when the association condition appears. With no explicit object, the trust attaches to the whole association-frame; the safety and trust field of {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) makes this more than bare assent, showing where they feel secure. The same audience is therefore religiously responsive in the wrong direction, matching the relief at others being mentioned in 39:45, and the hamza onset marks a small audible turn into that belief-response.

topics.headline: belief response under association condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief has no stated object and is syntactically dependent on the association frame.
topics.reason: The verb is the second-person response to the conditional association branch and lacks an explicit object.

topics.headline: felt security inside belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their belief sounds like misplaced trust and felt safety, while the local Form IV keeps the sense to trust-affirmation rather than seeking protection.
topics.reason: The root field includes safety, but the local response verb selects belief/trust under the association condition.

topics.headline: same audience trusts wrong condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group is religiously responsive, but its trust appears when association is present; 39:45 supplies the parallel joy at others being mentioned.
topics.reason: The second-person response pair and concrete 39:45 echo expose object-orientation rather than lack of responsiveness.

topics.headline: belief-response onset marked in sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small audible turn at the response verb after the association condition.
topics.reason: The sound row has local cadence payoff but does not change the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: result particle that pivots from exposed reversal to the judgment clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the exposed reversal into consequence. The particle snaps from the two unstable response-branches into a stable nominal judgment sentence, so the close reads as the verdict required by what the conditions revealed.

topics.headline: from reversal to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final judgment clause is drawn as consequence from the exposed contradiction.
topics.reason: The result particle is prefixed directly to the judgment noun and introduces the closing nominal clause.

topics.headline: volatile verbs to stable jurisdiction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from changing human reactions into a stable general principle of divine jurisdiction.
topics.reason: The particle introduces a verbless sentence after the conditional verbs, so the close generalizes the diagnostic contrast.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun naming judgment/rule as a whole domain assigned to Allah
words.root_gloss_range: judgment, ruling, command, governance, restraint, and firm ordering range; local maṣdar form makes this a domain of authority rather than one finite judging act
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحُكْمُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥukmu}}) names judgment as a definite domain, not a one-time act of judging. The root’s ruling, restraint, and ordering range makes the final claim broader than courtroom verdict alone, and the nominal form assigns the whole domain to Allah after the addressees’ criteria have collapsed. The clause states the principle later applied in 40:48 and echoed by judgment-belongs-to-Allah formulas in 12:40 and 6:57; its firm guttural entry makes the verdict sound heavier after the lighter conditional particles.

topics.headline: definite domain assigned to Allah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment is claimed as a whole stable domain, not as one isolated ruling or momentary act.
topics.reason: The definite maṣdar is the subject of a nominal possessive predicate, assigning the domain to Allah.

topics.headline: judgment as ordering restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ruling as restraint and governance over the disorder of the reversal, while local grammar keeps the selected sense within judgment/rule.
topics.reason: The root range broadens the payoff beyond courtroom verdict, but it remains anchored to the local judgment noun.

topics.headline: principle applied later and elsewhere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 40:12 stating the principle that 40:48 applies, with 12:40 and 6:57 supplying concrete judgment-belongs-to-Allah parallels.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references and show formulaic force without making them override the local nominal sentence.

topics.headline: guttural entry to verdict clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verdict clause beginning with a firmer sound after the lighter conditional particles.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally relevant to the semantic turn to judgment.

words.gloss_range: possessive/allocation preposition assigning the judgment-domain to Allah
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the ownership hinge of the verdict, assigning possession and specialization rather than mere direction or honor. After the opening causal preposition explained why the state exists, this closing preposition assigns who owns judgment, moving the ayah from diagnosis to exclusive jurisdiction.

topics.headline: judgment allocated to Allah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition assigns possession and specialization, not mere direction or honor.
topics.reason: The preposition forms the predicate of the nominal judgment clause and scopes over the judgment-domain.

topics.headline: cause to ownership arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s prepositions carrying movement from diagnosis of error to ownership of judgment.
topics.reason: The opening causal preposition and closing possessive preposition are locally visible and structurally paired.

words.gloss_range: divine name as genitive possessor completing the judgment predicate
words.root_gloss_range: worship, devotion, refuge, and turning pressure around the divine name; local grammar makes the name the possessor of judgment
words.prose: {{ar:لَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) completes the possessive predicate: judgment belongs to Allah. The same divine name that was resisted when invoked alone now appears as the owner of decision, so the structure closes off any escape through association; 6:57 supplies a concrete parallel for judgment being reserved to Allah. The devotion pressure around the name also makes the payoff sharper: the one who should receive exclusive devotion receives jurisdiction over misdirected devotion.

topics.headline: proper name completes predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment is grammatically assigned to a fixed divine possessor, not to an open class of authorities.
topics.reason: The divine name is governed by the possessive preposition and completes the predicate of the judgment clause.

topics.headline: devotion pressure meets judgment ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one who should receive exclusive devotion also receives jurisdiction over misdirected devotion, while derivational pressure stays within the proper-name role.
topics.reason: The worship/refuge field remains meaningful but is bounded by the genitive possessor grammar.

topics.headline: 6:57 judgment parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 6:57 gives a concrete parallel for reserving judgment to Allah amid denial.
topics.reason: The concrete reference supports formulaic resonance while the local predicate remains decisive.

topics.headline: invoked one becomes owner of decision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Allah, resisted in exclusive invocation, reappears as the owner of judgment over that resistance.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name links the first branch to the verdict clause.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive divine title of exalted height and rank attached to the judgment possessor
words.root_gloss_range: height, rising, superiority, rank, and transcendence range; local title form names inherent exaltation rather than comparison on a shared scale
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِىِّ}} ({{tr:al-ʿaliyyi}}) qualifies the owner of judgment, not the judgment-domain itself. Its height and rank field answers the horizontal sharing implied by association, while the stable title form keeps Allah above the partner-scale rather than merely higher than rivals; the title-pair recurs at 22:62 and 31:30.

topics.headline: title qualifies judgment’s owner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title attaches to Allah as judgment’s owner and names inherent exaltation, not a second predicate about judgment.
topics.reason: The title agrees in genitive definiteness with the divine-name chain and functions as an attribute.

topics.headline: height becomes transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices vertical transcendence answering horizontal association, while the physical height image is narrowed into divine rank and title-force.
topics.reason: The root field supplies height imagery, but the local definite title makes it a divine attribute beyond comparison.

topics.headline: first half of recurring title-pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the title forming the first half of a known pair with the greatness title, a pair also used at 22:62 and 31:30.
topics.reason: The concrete references and local pairing preserve formulaic payoff without altering the grammar.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive divine title of greatness and magnitude completing the closing title chain
words.root_gloss_range: bigness, gravity, greatness, and self-magnification range; local title form assigns true sovereign greatness to Allah, not comparative rivalry
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَبِيرِ}} ({{tr:al-kabīri}}) completes the closing title chain with sovereign magnitude. The greatness field displaces both partner-claims and human self-magnifying preference, and because this is the final word, the ayah lands on divine magnitude rather than on the addressees’ belief or rejection. The known title-pair parallel in 31:30 and the sustained final cadence make that magnitude the semantic and acoustic seal.

topics.headline: final title continues attribute chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is still describing the possessor of judgment, not starting a new clause or comparison.
topics.reason: The title agrees with the preceding genitive definite chain and completes the appositional predicate tail.

topics.headline: greatness displaces partner scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices true sovereign magnitude overwhelming partner-claims and human self-magnification, while the title form keeps this from becoming comparative rivalry.
topics.reason: The root range includes size and arrogance, but the local divine title assigns stable greatness to Allah.

topics.headline: final greatness seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on divine greatness, with 31:30 supplying a concrete title-pair parallel and the final cadence sealing the reversal.
topics.reason: The final position, recurrence rows, and concrete parallel together make magnitude the semantic and acoustic landing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed conditions in "when God is called alone, you reject" and "if a partner is assigned to Him, you believe."
baseline_models.mechanism: The invocation's configuration acts as a trust test: an unshared divine claim triggers covering and refusal, whereas a shared arrangement supplies the audience with security and assent. The problem is therefore not absence of belief as such, but belief switching on when authority is distributed.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the summons whose configuration tests the hearers.
Unity without partner supplies the deliberately unshared pole of the test.
Covering supplies a material image for suppressing the sole claim rather than merely lacking information.
A stake shared among partners supplies the arrangement that makes assent acceptable.
Security and trust make "believe" an affective reliance response, not only a proposition.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts monotheism with polytheism.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a trust switch: the audience rejects an undivided claim yet feels able to assent when agency and liability appear shareable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The result clause "so judgment belongs to God, the High, the Great."
baseline_models.mechanism: After the audience tries to allocate a divine share, the result clause reserves both restraint and adjudication to God. Highness as mastery and greatness as rightful majesty remove that jurisdiction from the peer scale on which partners could be added.

activation_trace.role: Restraint that checks corruption makes judgment the brake on the audience's attempted allocation.
Adjudication between parties supplies the exclusive jurisdiction asserted by the clause.
Mastery and prevailing power place the judge above every proposed co-holder.
Rightful majesty supplies a greatness that cannot be partitioned among rival claimants.

changed_reading.before: The closing names say that God will judge and is exalted.
changed_reading.after: The close actively voids the hearers' allocation scheme: the restraining and deciding jurisdiction remains with the One whose mastery is outside partner comparison.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive constructions "God is called" and "a partner is assigned," followed by the exclusive ownership of judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can be heard not only as prayer but as advancing a claim or entitlement. On that branch, the audience rejects the sole claim, endorses a shared claim, and is then told who alone has authority to validate claims.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation lets the invocation function as a claim advanced for God.
Shared ownership supplies the rival proposal to divide that claim.
Heart-settling assent is the audience's endorsement of the divided proposal.
Delegated arbitration raises the question of who was ever authorized to validate the proposed shares.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports two opposite worship reactions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it stages competing entitlement claims and closes by denying that the audience can authorize or arbitrate a share in divinity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated command to call God while purifying din turns "alone" from a bare number into an operation: mixed allegiance is cleared of added shares, and obedience is handed over without residue.

activation_trace.role: No-partner unity remains the focus anchor whose practical form the context supplies.
Purification after admixture supplies the removal process implicit in calling God alone.
Exclusive singling apart from partnership makes the removed admixture specifically a rival share.
Obedience and yielding identify what is being purified, not merely the wording of a prayer.
Handing over and releasing control supplies the positive transfer that follows removal of rival allegiances.

structural_cues: 40:66 places worship of those called besides God against the command to submit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated call-purify-din language and images of purification, exclusive singling, obedience, and transfer; I infer that "alone" demands clearing mixed allegiance. A live alternative limits ikhlas to inward sincerity without a social or juridical transfer.

changed_reading.before: Calling God alone means mentioning only one deity.
changed_reading.after: Calling God alone is a de-mixing act that clears obedience of co-claims and transfers allegiance without a retained share.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah tests ownership of judgment by efficacy: God decides in truth, invoked alternatives decide nothing, His decided command becomes, and the final arrival of His command enacts judgment. Exclusive judgment is therefore operative jurisdiction, not a title.

activation_trace.role: Adjudication supplies the focus claim that the context subjects to an efficacy test.
Cutting judgment marks both God's true decision and the called alternatives' inability to decide anything.
The same calling relation identifies the alternatives whose jurisdiction fails.
Perfecting and executing an act supplies the causal force of the decided matter.
Binding command supplies the content that becomes effective with "Be."
The decisive judgment with truth supplies the public enactment of the focus clause.
Actual loss supplies the measurable consequence of failed rival jurisdiction.

structural_cues: 40:20 directly contrasts God's judging with the non-judging of those called besides Him.
40:68 and 40:78 move from decision to effective command and final adjudication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit decision contrasts, an executed command, and final loss; I infer that efficacy is the criterion by which the focus reserves judgment to God. A live alternative keeps creative command and courtroom judgment as separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Judgment belongs to God as a future verdict.
changed_reading.after: Judgment belongs to God because His decisions alone cut, execute, and produce consequences; the invoked partners fail the jurisdiction test in the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing man's dialogue makes calling bidirectional recruitment: he calls his people toward rescue, they call him toward fire by demanding rejection and partnership, and their object is denied any valid call or claim. The focus reaction belongs to a contested summons network.

activation_trace.role: A claimed right or affiliation anchors the exploratory claim dimension in the focus call.
Opposed verbal summonses supply reciprocal recruitment toward rescue and fire.
Shared participation supplies the concrete demand carried by the counter-summons.
The denied call or claim strips the rival object of entitlement in both worlds.

structural_cues: 40:41-42 reverse "I call you" and "you call me" before naming rejection and partnership.
40:43 says the object of their invitation has no call in either world.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal summonses, an explicit partnership demand, and denial of the rival's da'wah; I infer that invitation and entitlement reinforce each other. A live alternative reads da'wah throughout only as invitation or prayer, without a legal claim sense.

changed_reading.before: The focus call is an isolated act of invocation.
changed_reading.after: The focus call sits inside rival recruitment and claim-making: assent to partnership is participation in a counter-summons whose object has no valid entitlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Followers ask their former superiors to absorb or offset an allotted share of punishment, but the superiors cannot suffice and answer that God has already judged. Partnership-based trust is exposed as imagined risk pooling: shared authority promised distributed liability, yet no patron can carry another's portion.

activation_trace.role: Shared stakes anchor the focus arrangement that is tested as a liability network.
Security and reliance identify why a distributed arrangement could attract belief.
Binding liability in followership supplies the obligation the followers try to transfer upward.
Sufficiency supplies the patrons' tested and failed ability to cover their followers.
An assigned share supplies the portion of liability the followers ask others to absorb.
God's completed adjudication terminates every attempted redistribution among patrons and followers.
The redirected request to the keepers extends the failed chain of delegated calling.

structural_cues: 40:47-48 stages followers, arrogant leaders, an allotted portion, failed sufficiency, and God's judgment in one exchange.
40:49-50 continues with another delegated call that produces no relief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies followership liability, an allotted share, failed sufficiency, and final judgment; I infer that the focus audience trusts partnership partly as risk distribution. A live alternative treats the scene as generic failed patronage without explaining the earlier attraction of partnership.

changed_reading.before: Belief in partners is a mistaken inventory of divine beings.
changed_reading.after: Belief in partners is also reliance on a distributed responsibility system whose patrons are expected to absorb risk but cannot alter a single judged share.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh converts inner self-magnification into a high structure and an attempted route of attainment and inspection. The focus names "the High, the Great" then distinguish divine mastery from both built altitude and greatness manufactured in the chest but never reached.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing mastery anchors highness as authority rather than merely physical elevation.
Rightful majesty anchors the scale against which human self-magnification is exposed.
The high building supplies Pharaoh's fabricated vertical substitute for divine highness.
Reaching a limit supplies the attempted conversion of height into access.
A rope or connection supplies the imagined means linking the tower to the divine domain.
Overlooking and uncovering supply Pharaoh's attempt to inspect and master what exceeds him.
The chest as the source of action locates the rival vertical project internally before it becomes public.
Human pride supplies the counterfeit greatness driving dispute.
Failure to reach the sought limit explicitly denies that counterfeit greatness its goal.

structural_cues: 40:35 joins disputation, magnified loathing, a sealed arrogant heart, and coercion immediately before the tower project.
40:56 relocates the same kibr to the chest and says its possessors will not attain it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a high structure, connective means, attempted attainment, inspection, inner kibr, and non-attainment; I infer that the focus titles deconstruct fabricated vertical sovereignty. A live alternative treats the tower episode as ridicule of Pharaoh without making it a calibration of "High, Great."

changed_reading.after: They deny that sovereignty can be reached by built altitude or produced by self-enlargement: divine highness is mastery, while the rival height begins as unattainable kibr in the chest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command "Call Me; I respond to you" reverses the focus response direction: God answers the undivided call, while humans who reject it are identified as self-magnifying against worship and end abased. The true call is a reciprocal circuit broken by counterfeit greatness.

activation_trace.role: The focus summons anchors the human response side of the circuit.
Rightful divine greatness anchors the contrast with human self-magnification.
The direct call supplies the input to God's promised response.
Submissive worship identifies the relation from which the rejecters magnify themselves.
Self-arrogation of greatness supplies the blockage in the call-response circuit.
Abasement supplies the terminal reversal of claimed human greatness.

structural_cues: 40:60 places call, divine response, arrogance from worship, and abasement in one causal sequence.
The focus likewise places call, human rejection, and the divine title "Great" in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies God's promised answer and the arrogance-to-abasement sequence; I infer a reciprocal circuit in which the focus records the human side failing. A live alternative limits "I respond" to granting petitions rather than a broader reciprocity of recognition.

changed_reading.before: The focus only asks how humans respond when God is invoked.
changed_reading.after: The undivided call opens a two-way response: God answers, but self-magnifying humans refuse worship; "the Great" names the rightful pole that their pride counterfeits.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the surah's end the focus polarity reverses almost word for word: after seeing overwhelming force, they believe in God alone and disavow what they had partnered. The next ayah says that this sight-triggered faith no longer benefits, making judgment a response deadline rather than only a verdict.

activation_trace.role: Denial of the sole claim supplies the initial polarity that the ending reverses.
No-partner unity supplies the initially rejected object.
Association with God supplies the initially accepted object.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response whose object and timing change.
Direct sight supplies the new evidentiary threshold that triggers reversal.
Overwhelming force supplies the coercive object of that sight.
Assent now moves to God rather than to the partnered arrangement.
God without partner becomes the now-confessed object.
Disavowal and renunciation reverse kufr's object from God-alone to the former partners.
The former association is explicitly named as what they now renounce.
Failure of benefit marks the reversed response as pragmatically too late.
A recurrent governing course turns the failed late reversal into a stable response rule.

structural_cues: 40:84 repeats belief, God alone, rejection, and partnership in the opposite alignment from 40:12.
40:85 repeats sight of force and faith, then explicitly denies that faith benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact lexical reversal and ties it to sight of force and non-benefit; I infer that the decisive difference is the response threshold, with compelled recognition arriving after judgment becomes visible. A live alternative grounds the failure of late faith in a rule other than coercive timing.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a fixed identity: rejecters of God-alone are believers in partnership.
changed_reading.after: It captures an earlier phase in a reversible polarity: judgment eventually flips both belief and rejection, but a sight-compelled flip arrives after responsive faith can benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-root material analogy, not a derivation or claim that kufr and forgiveness are lexically identical. It remains anchored in the focus's covering branch and in the surah's repeated protective-covering branch for forgiveness; downstream prose should render it as a contrast in the object and effect of covering.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the human act that hides the sole divine claim.
A covering that protects supplies the divine counter-image announced at the surah's opening.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer from effect supplies the requested protective direction.
The Forgiver appears as the destination of the believer's rival call, keeping protective covering inside the call contest.

changed_reading.before: Kufr in the focus is simply rejection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah contrasts two coverings: humans cover the sole claim to suppress it, while God covers sin to protect its bearer; judgment distinguishes concealment from preservation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hunter's-snare branch of shirk is branch-distant and must not replace the ordinary partnership sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the immediate chain-dragging scene before the partners are questioned; downstream prose should present it only as a materialized image of entanglement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus passive "if a partner is assigned to Him."

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies an exploratory entanglement image inside the focus root.
A collar binding the limb materializes restraint around the neck.
Connected links supply the extended binding mechanism.
Dragging and extending supplies the motion imposed by the binding.
The direct question about their divine partners reconnects the restraint scene to the ordinary focus sense.

changed_reading.before: Partnership is an additive belief that gives the audience reassurance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the added relation is also a snare: the trusted network becomes visible at judgment as linked restraint and involuntary dragging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation shifts the social effect of "alone" from its grammatical referent, God, to the human confessor, so it must not be presented as the syntax of 40:12. It remains worth carrying because the surah places concealed individual faith inside parties and later exposes follower loyalty; downstream prose should qualify it as a social consequence of exclusive allegiance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collision between "God alone" and the shared-stake branch of partnership.

activation_trace.role: Separation and being without a companion supplies the social cost potentially radiating from exclusive allegiance.
Shared participation supplies the socially populated alternative.
A party gathered around one view supplies the coalition environment in which calls are heard.
Concealing faith supplies evidence that exclusive allegiance can isolate its bearer within the ruling household.
Trust borne by the concealed believer supplies the costly alternative to coalition-backed security.
Loyal following supplies the social attachment that partnership-like authority preserves until it fails.

changed_reading.before: The audience prefers more than one divine object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the audience also prefers the coalition security of shared allegiance; confessing God alone can leave the confessor socially alone, as the concealed believer's position makes visible.

strongest_changes: The focus antithesis became a trust-distribution mechanism: undivided authority triggers covering, while shared stakes offer apparent security.
The surah expands calling into rival recruitment, entitlement, and reciprocal response, not merely an isolated prayer formula.
Exclusive judgment became effective jurisdiction, tested by the partners' inability to decide, execute, or redistribute liability.
40:84-85 reverses the focus polarity almost word for word and shows that sight-compelled faith arrives after it can benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reactivated the exact focus roots in juridical, social, vertical, material, and temporal scenes, allowing several mechanisms to coexist without collapsing them into one doctrinal paraphrase.
remaining_uncertainties: The claim-entitlement branch of da'wah may be activated chiefly by 40:43 rather than already active in the focus.
The risk-pooling and social-isolation models are coherent narrative mechanisms but remain inferential rather than syntactically stated.
The counter-covering and partner-snare images are cross-root or branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The issue is the social architecture of the call.** `د ع و/B001` draws toward an addressee, while `ش ر ك/B001` supplies shared participation. The opposed conditionals contrast a single destination with distributed partnership. I infer that acceptance depends on preserving multiple claimants; the ayah reads disbelief as resistance to an undivided relational center, before judgment removes that partition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The missing partners in 40:73–74 convert the ayah’s single-versus-shared contrast into a locational test that partnership fails.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Judgment corrects an inverted response-pattern.** Lexically, `ح ك م:B001` is "restraining and turning back to set right," `و ح د:B004` is God's exclusive oneness, and `ش ر ك:B001` is sharing or partnership. Structurally, the addressees cover when God alone is called yet assent when sharing is introduced; the closing judgment follows their failed request for an exit in 40:11 and precedes the judgment-day sequence in 40:15-17. Judgment's role is corrective restraint upon a response that runs backward. The packet gives the inversion and then `فالحكم`; I infer that the ruling answers and turns back that inversion. The ending reads as functionally corrective, not merely as a detached assertion of sovereignty.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:65-66 repeats exclusive invocation and submission, but 40:84-85 corrects a possible overreading: exclusive words uttered only under visible force do not repair the earlier inversion.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ses ve söz yoluyla bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmeyi temel anlam olarak verir; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yere yönelmeyi de bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlar olarak gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel seslenme anlamı, yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen yemeğe çağırma ve bir yere yönelme kullanımlarından ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ses ve söz kullanarak birini ya da bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmektir. Yemeğe çağırma ve bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Ses ve söz, yöneltilen kişiyi ya da şeyi konuşana doğru çekmenin aracıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sonraki sütü çekmek için memede bırakılan süt payı

error_profile.preserves: Sağım sonrasında memede bir miktar süt bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sütün bilerek bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Memede kalan sütün sonraki sütü getirmesi için bilerek bırakılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memede kalan sütün az ve yudumluk miktarda oluşunu anlatır; özel bir işlev şart koşmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sağım sonrasında memede bulunan küçük bir süt miktarını konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalanın amacıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise miktarın azlığıyla tanımlanır ve sonraki sütü çekme işlevini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süt akışını uyarmak için memede bırakılan sütün kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memeyi sıvazlayarak sütü indirme eylemini ve bu yolla süt veren hayvanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da memeden yeni süt akışını başlatma veya sürdürme amacı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uyarıcı araç memede bırakılan süt payıdır; komşuda araç memenin sıvazlanmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir miktar sütü sonraki akışı sağlamak üzere memede bırakmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Parmak uçlarıyla az az sağmayı, yavaş akışı ve kalan sütü çekip almayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da memedeki az miktardaki süt ve sağımın sürdürülmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sütü bırakır ve işlevini bekler; komşu dal az miktardaki sütü belirli bir sağım biçimiyle dışarı alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi. Seçilen komşular, amaçlı bırakılan süt payını az süt kalıntısından, memeyi sıvazlamaktan ve az az sağmaktan ayırır; öteki adaylar sağımın başka aşamalarına veya kardeş anlamlara aittir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دعوة الطعام ولا دعوة النسب ولا دعاء الصوت العام
branches.source_phrase_ar: داعية اللبن ما يترك في الضرع ليدعو ما بعده

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan çerçeve bunu birine kötülük gelmesi için söz söyleme olarak sunarken kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'nın kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı şeyi getirmesini ve olayın gerçekleşmesini anlatır. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım sözlü dilekten gerçekleşen sıkıntıya kaydırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, belirli yapıda Tanrı'nın istenmeyen bir şeyi kişinin başına getirmesidir; kötülük dileme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Düzeltilen anlam yalnızca verilen Tanrı, kişi ve istenmeyen sonuç yapısında geçerlidir; yalın çağırma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapıda, Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına onun hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesini anlatır. Odak, birinin kötülük dilemesi değil, istenmeyen olayın kişiye yönelip gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Tanrı, kişiye onun hoşlanmadığı bir şeyi yöneltir ve başına getirir.
Kaynak açıklaması sözlü bir kötülük isteğini değil, istenmeyen sonucun kişide gerçekleşmesini öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, Tanrı'nın bir kişiye hoşlanmadığı şeyi indirmesi veya başına getirmesi sonucunu bildirir; sözlü bir kötülük dileme işlemi belirtmez.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'nın birine istemediği bir sıkıntıyı vermesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına o kişinin hoşlanmadığı bir olay veya sıkıntı getirdiğini bildiren özel yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyenin Tanrı olmasını, etkilenen kişiyi ve onun istemediği sonucun gerçekleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleyeni geri planda bırakıp kişi açısından gerçekleşen istenmeyen sonucu anlatmak gerektiğinde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntının gelmesi sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Sonucu Tanrı'nın meydana getirdiğini açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın birinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesi

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiye yönelen istenmeyen sonuç düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynakta bildirilen gerçekleşmiş ilahi yöneltme ve meydana gelme ilişkisini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Bir insanın sözlü istekte bulunduğu ayrı bir konuşma eylemi ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sonucun gerçekleşmesini, o sonucun gerçekleşmesini isteme eylemiyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı'nın istenmeyen şeyi kişinin başına getirmesi ve sonucun gerçekleşmesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin başkasına kötülük yönelten söz söylemesi öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir kişinin başına kötü bir şey gelmesi düşüncesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçekleşen ilahi yöneltmeyi bildirir; komşu dal ise kötü sonucun gerçekleşmesi için söylenen sözü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İstenmeyen sonucun Tanrı tarafından kişiye verilmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Lanetleme ve karşılıklı olarak yalancının cezalandırılmasını isteme törenlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Tanrı ile ilişkilendirilen kötü bir sonucun kişiye yönelmesi sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sonuç bildiren özel bir yapıdır; komşu dal sözlü lanetleme veya karşılıklı sınama eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıkıntının belirli bir eyleyen tarafından kişiye getirilmesi ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, zarar veya güçlüğün kendisini ve onun yoğunluğunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin yaşadığı hoş olmayan ve zarar verici durumu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sıkıntının kişiye yöneltilmesini anlatır; komşu dal yönelten bir eyleyen gerektirmeden sıkıntı durumunu adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Seçilenler gerçekleşen sıkıntıyı kötülük dileme, lanetleme ve sıkıntının kendisinden ayırır; kalanlar uzak sonuç türleri veya bu kökün başka dallarıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: إنزال المكروه بأحد في قولهم دعا الله فلانا بما يكره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دعاء العبادة ولا الدعوة إلى الطعام ولا ادعاء النسب
branches.source_phrase_ar: دعا الله فلانا بما يكره أي أنزل به ذلك

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı süreci açıkça verir: duvarların birbiri ardından çökmesi ve yapıların birbiri ardından yıkılması. Hazırlanan çerçeve, ardışıklığı ve çökme ile ettirgen yıkma ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birbiri ardından gerçekleşme her iki kullanımda da kurucudur; tek bir çökme veya tek seferde yıkma dalın tamamını karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kendiliğinden ardışık çöküş ile bir eyleyenin ardışık yıkması ayrı yapılara bağlı iki facet olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yapının parçalarının birbiri ardından çökmesi veya bir eyleyenin onları birbiri ardından yıkmasıdır. Her iki durumda da tek olay değil, birbirini izleyen bir bozulma dizisi vardır.

facets.statement: Yapısal bozulma tek seferde değil, parçaların birbirini izlemesiyle gerçekleşir.
Duvarlar veya yapı parçaları kendiliğinden birbiri ardından çöker.
Bir eyleyen, yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine birbiri ardından yıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, ardışık çöküşü ve ardışık ettirgen yıkmayı aynı sıra ilişkisi altında birleştirir; eyleyenin bulunup bulunmaması iki kullanımı ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem yapı parçalarının sırayla çökmesini hem de bir eyleyenin onları sırayla yıkmasını kapsayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ardışıklığı, yapısal bozulmayı ve kendiliğinden çökme ile ettirgen yıkma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duvar veya yapı parçalarının kendiliğinden ve sırayla düştüğü kullanım için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapı parçalarının ardışık biçimde çökmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir eyleyenin parçaları birbiri ardından yıkması kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eyleyenin yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine sırayla yıktığı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen yıkmayı ve parçaların sıra ile devrilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yapının kendiliğinden ardışık çökmesi kullanımını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirerek düşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Parçaların birbiri ardından gelmesini ve ettirgen yıkma kullanımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çöküşün veya yıkmanın parçalar arasında sıra halinde ilerlemesini ve ettirgen seçeneği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin genel olarak düşmesi veya yıkılmasını, ayrıca ağacın kökünden çıkmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirip çökmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için ardışıklık kurucudur; komşu dal tek bir çöküşü de kapsar ve sıra ilişkisi gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birbiri ardından çökme veya yıkma düzenini vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yıkılmanın taşıyıcı düzeni, gücü veya itibarı ortadan kaldıran sonucunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapıların yıkılması ve ayakta tutan düzenin bozulması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayların sırasıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise yıkımın dayanıklılığı ve düzeni yok eden sonucuyla tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birden çok parçanın birbirini izleyerek çökmesini veya yıkılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yapının ya da kenarın yüksekten aşağıya veya çukura doğru çöküş yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yapı parçalarının düşmesi ve bütünlüğün bozulması olayını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği ardışık sıra, komşunun ayırıcı özelliği ise aşağıya veya derine doğru çöküş yönüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi. Yayınlanan komşular ardışıklık sınırını genel çökme, sonucu öne çıkan yıkım ve aşağı yönlü çöküşten ayırır; kalan adaylar kırma, zayıflama, düzleme veya kardeş anlam alanlarında daha uzaktır.
branches.what_is_ar: سقوط بعض الشيء إثر بعض وهدمه واحدا بعد آخر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النداء بالكلام ولا ادعاء الحق ولا دعوة الطعام
branches.source_phrase_ar: تداعت الحيطان وذلك إذا سقط واحد وآخر بعده؛ داعيناها عليهم إذا هدمناها واحدا بعد آخر

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dönemin değişimlerini ve olayların yönünü değiştirmelerini anlatır. Hazırlanan çerçevenin olaylar ve yön verme bölümü uygundur, ancak insanın bu olaylara eğilmesi kaynakta kurucu bir katılımcı olarak açıkça verilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, insanın yönelmesini değil, dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimlerini merkeze alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca dönemin yön verici değişimleri yapısına bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel bir olay veya çağırma anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimleri ve getirdiği gelişmelerdir. Yöneltme düşüncesi burada sesli bir çağrı değil, olayların seyrine etki eden mecazlı bir güçtür.

facets.statement: Dönem, değişen koşullar ve gelişmeler yoluyla olayların akışına yön verir.
Olayların başka yöne çevrilmesi, temel yöneltme ilişkisini zamansal değişimlere taşıyan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen güçler olarak sunar; insanın bu değişimlere çekilmesi kaynak ifadesinde zorunlu bir öğe değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dönemin getirdiği değişimlerin olayların seyrini etkilediğini anlatan özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönemin değişimlerini, olayları ve bu değişimlerin yön verici etkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yön verme benzetisini açmadan, dönem içinde meydana gelen değişim ve gelişmeleri doğal Türkçeyle anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Dönemin değişkenliğini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan olayları korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu değişimlerin olayların yönünü çevirdiği mecazlı ilişkiyi açıkça göstermez.

error_profile.preserves: Olayların yön verici bir etkisi olduğu düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dönemin değişimleri ile olayların seyrinin yön değiştirmesi arasındaki bağı zayıflatır.
error_profile.adds: Kaynakta kurucu olmayan insan katılımcısını ve onun edilgin biçimde sürüklenmesini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Olayların yönünün değişmesi ile insanın olaylara kapılması birbirine karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen bir güç olarak kavramlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dönemin insanlar üzerinde gerçekleşen türlü olaylarını ve bazı kullanımlarda gece ile gündüzü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dönem içinde ortaya çıkan değişimleri ve olayların değişken seyrini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yön verme benzetisiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal daha genel olayları ve daha geniş zamansal kullanımları kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Değişimleri, olumlu veya olumsuz değer yüklemeden olayların yönünü değiştirmeleri bakımından ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Beklenen veya korkulan uğursuz gelişmeler ve belirsizlik duygusunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dönemin getirdiği değişimleri ve beklenmedik gelişmeleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel yön değişimini anlatır; komşu dal değişimlerin kaygı, kuşku ve kötü beklenti doğuran yönüyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü karşılaştırıldı. İki yakın komşu, yön verici dönem değişimini genel dönem olaylarından ve kaygı uyandıran gelişmelerden ayırır; diğer adaylar ölüm, insanın durumu, yaklaşan sonuç veya kardeş anlamlarla daha dolaylı ilişkilidir.
branches.what_is_ar: صروف الدهر وحوادثه التي تميل الإنسان إليها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دعاء الصوت ولا ادعاء النسب ولا تداعي الحيطان
branches.source_phrase_ar: دواعي الدهر صروفه كأنها تميل الحوادث

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gizlenmiş cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için karşılıklı olarak sorulan bilmece türü soruları ve birine böyle bir soru yöneltme eylemini birlikte verir. Hazırlanan çerçeve bu soru, gizleme ve cevap çıkarma ilişkisini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan anlaşılmaz sözü değil, gizlenmiş bir cevabı buldurmak üzere yöneltilen bilmece ve sınama eylemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bilmece olarak kullanılan adlandırma ile birine bilmece yöneltme eylemi ayrı facetlerde korunur; anlam genel seslenmeye yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gizlenmiş bir cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için birine yöneltilen bilmece türü soru veya böyle sorularla karşılıklı sınamadır. Soru, muhatabı örtülü cevabı bulup söylemeye çağırır.

facets.statement: Soru, cevabı doğrudan vermeyip onu örtülü ve çözülmesi gereken halde sunar.
Kişiler bu tür soruları birbirlerine yönelterek karşılıklı bir sınama yürütür.
Eylem biçimi, muhataba bir bilmece sunup gizli cevabı ondan istemeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, bilmece niteliğindeki örtülü soruyu, bu sorularla karşılıklı sınamayı ve muhataptan gizli cevabı çıkarma amacını birlikte temellendirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Örtülü bir cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için kişilerin birbirine bilmece türü soru yönelttiği kavramı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli cevabı, onu buldurma amacını, bilmece biçimini ve karşılıklı sınamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin muhatabına örtülü cevabı bulması için soru yönelttiği eylem bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Birine çözülmesi gereken örtülü bir soru yöneltme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Soruların karşılıklı yürütülmesini ve cevabı özellikle ortaya çıkarma benzetisini tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişilerin birbirine örtülü sorular yönelterek cevap verme gücünü denediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklılığı, bilmece biçimini ve sınama işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gizlenmiş cevabı muhataptan ortaya çıkarma yönünü açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gizli cevabı buldurmak için karşılıklı sorulan bilmeceler

error_profile.preserves: İçeriğin hemen anlaşılmaması ve çözüm gerektirmesi yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Soru biçimini, gizli cevabı buldurma amacını ve karşılıklı sınamayı kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Cevabı olmayan her türlü belirsiz veya bozuk sözü kapsayabilir.
error_profile.collision: Amaçlı bilmeceyi rastgele anlaşılmaz anlatımla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örtülü soruyu bir muhataba yöneltir ve ondan gizli cevabı ortaya çıkarmasını ister.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sözü veya nesneyi genel olarak anlaşılması güç hale getirmeyi, soru ve cevap düzeni aramadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da anlamı hemen erişilemez kılan örtme ve çözme gereksinimini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal amaçlı bir bilmece ve cevap isteme eylemidir; komşu dal daha geniş biçimde sözü anlaşılmazlaştırmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Muhatabı güç bir soruyla cevap vermeye ve örtülü çözümü bulmaya yöneltir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin cevap bulamadığı veya sözü tükendiği için susmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, zor bir söz karşısında cevap verme veya cevap verememe sahnesinde birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal soruyu yönelten sınama eylemidir; komşu dal ise sınanan kişinin cevapsız kalmasının sonucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi. Seçilen iki komşu bilmeceyi genel anlaşılmazlaştırmadan ve cevapsız kalma sonucundan ayırır; kalan adaylar doğrulama, bilgi, çelişki, karşı koyma veya kardeş anlamlarla yalnızca uzak bağ taşır.
branches.what_is_ar: الأُدْعِيّة التي يتداعون بها مثل الأغلوطة لإخراج الجواب المعمى

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir ev yapısında hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını, seslenebilecek tek bir kişinin bile olmaması üzerinden açıklar. Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi hem yokluk sonucunu hem de ses veren kimse benzetisini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam belirli olumsuz ev ifadesine bağlıdır ve genel olarak boşluk, sessizlik veya eşyasızlık bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hiç kimsenin bulunmadığı anlamı yalnızca verilen kalıplaşmış olumsuz yapıda geçerlidir; yalın biçime taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir olumsuz ev ifadesinde, içeride hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını bildirir. Açıklayıcı benzetme, seslenip bağıracak tek bir kişinin bile olmayışıdır.

facets.statement: Belirtilen evde hiçbir insan bulunmaz.
İnsan yokluğu, evde seslenebilecek veya bağırabilecek kimsenin bulunmamasıyla açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, belirli olumsuz yapıdaki insan yokluğu anlamını, evde ses çıkarıp çağırabilecek kimsenin bulunmaması benzetisiyle açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli yapının bir evde tek bir insanın bile bulunmadığını bildiren tam anlamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ev sınırını, insan yokluğunu ve yokluğun eksiksiz oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güncel Türkçede evde hiçbir insan bulunmadığını doğal ve doğrudan biçimde bildirir.

error_profile.preserves: Evde hiçbir insanın bulunmadığı temel sonucu eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Seslenip bağıracak birinin bile olmayışı üzerinden kurulan açıklayıcı benzetiyi göstermez.

error_profile.preserves: Evde insan bulunmaması olasılığını ve genel yokluk düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: İfadenin yalnızca insan bulunmadığını kesin biçimde bildiren sınırını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Eşya, kullanım veya yaşam belirtisi bulunmadığı anlamlarını da ekleyebilir.
error_profile.collision: İnsan yokluğunu evin eşyasız ya da kullanılmıyor olmasıyla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kalıplaşmış olumsuz bir ev ifadesiyle içeride tek bir kişinin bile bulunmadığını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kavramsal çekirdek ve sınır aynıdır; ayrım yalnızca bu anlamı taşıyan kalıplaşmış sözlerin farklı oluşudur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da belirli bir evde hiçbir insan bulunmadığını kalıplaşmış olumsuz sözle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam ve kullanım sınırı örtüşür; yalnızca insan yokluğunu anlatmak için seçilen sözlü görüntü farklıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan yokluğunu evle sınırlı özel bir ifade ve seslenebilecek kimse benzetisiyle kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan yokluğunu ev dışındaki bir yer için de kullanılabilen başka bir dar ifadeyle bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir yerde tek bir insanın bile bulunmadığını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ev ve seslenen kişi görüntüsüne bağlıdır; komşu dalın yer sınırı daha geneldir ve aynı açıklayıcı görüntüyü taşımaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir evde insan bulunmamasını ses verecek kimsenin yokluğuyla açıklar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yerde hiç kimse veya hiçbir belirti bulunmamasını daha geniş bir yokluk alanında kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir mekanın insanlardan yoksun oluşunu kalıplaşmış olumsuz ifadelerle bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnızca evde insan yokluğudur; komşu dal yer sınırını genişletir ve insan dışında belirti yokluğuna da uzanabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. İki tam eşdeğer ve iki yakın komşu, evde insan yokluğunu başka kalıplaşmış yokluk ifadeleriyle karşılaştırır; diğer adaylar ikamet, ıssızlık, sessizlik, hazır bulunan topluluk veya kardeş anlamlar nedeniyle daha uzaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi itme eyleminde birleşir; ancak sertlik, kabalık ve azarlama niteliği bütün aktarımlarda aynı ölçüde kurucu değildir. Bu yüzden dal, sıradan itme çekirdeğini koruyup sert ve kaba gerçekleşmeleri belirgin kullanımlar olarak ayırmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel itmedir; sertlik ve azarlama bazı kullanımları daraltır, doldurma veya seslenme anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak itme çekirdeğiyle yapıya bağlı sertçe sürme ve azarlama örneklerini ayırır; özel yapılar bütün dalın anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini ya da bir şeyi itmek; belirli kullanımlarda bunu sertçe, kaba davranarak veya azarlayıcı biçimde yapmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir varlığı bulunduğu yerden fiziksel güçle itme eylemidir.
Eylem sertlik, kabalık ve azarlama eşliğinde gerçekleşebilir.
Bazı yapılarda savunmasız birini itip azarlamayı veya bir yere zorla sürmeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar itme çekirdeğinde birleşir; bir bölümü eylemin sert, kaba ve azarlayıcı niteliğini ayrıca öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bütün kullanımlarında bulunan temel fiziksel yer değiştirme eylemi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel güçle yerinden oynatma çekirdeğini tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sertliğin veya kaba davranışın açıkça öne çıktığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem itme eylemini hem de eylemin sert gerçekleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin belirli bir yöne veya yere şiddetle sevk edildiği yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlayıcı güç ve yönlü hareket özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yön belirtmeyen yalın itme kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Zor kullanılarak yer değiştirme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek hamlelik itme ve azarlayıcı sertlik ayrımını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Temasın sürmesi ve nesnenin çekilmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Türkçede çekerek ilerletme eylemiyle karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, kaba davranış ve azarlama eşliğindeki itmeye kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal zorlama, delme ve bir şeyi başka bir şeye güçle sokma kapsamını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güçlü ve sert bir fiziksel itme eylemini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sınırı itme ve onun kaba ya da azarlayıcı gerçekleşmesidir; komşu dal ise baskı kurma, delme ve güçle içeri sokma gibi daha geniş zorlayıcı işlemleri de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sertlik ve kaba azarlama niteliğini belirginleştirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal itmenin yanında çarpma, engelleme ve kendini savunma yönlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir varlığı güç uygulayarak geri veya yana itme bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eylemin sert ve kaba biçimine yoğunlaşır; komşu dalın ayırıcı yönü bir şeyi uzak tutma, engelleme veya karşı koymadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; itmenin güç ve sınır farklarını en açık gösteren iki komşu seçildi, yalnızca aynı olay alanını paylaşan uzak adaylar elendi.
